examples.claim: HTTPOptions host defaults to localhost; 0.0.0.0 / :: to expose; location deprecated
examples.source: HTTPOptions API: 'Defaults to localhost. To expose Serve publicly, you probably want to set this to "0.0.0.0" for IPv4 or "::" for IPv6'; 'location: [DEPRECATED: use proxy_location field instead]' (note: config-file page says host defaults to 0.0.0.0; post does not flag this conflict)

examples.claim: Requests of 100KiB+ go through the object store, read zero-copy
examples.source: architecture: 'Larger request objects (100KiB+) are written to the object store and the replica can read them via zero-copy read.'

examples.claim: Power of two choices; no replica handles more than max_ongoing_requests
examples.source: architecture: 'power of two choices scheduling strategy, subject to the constraint that no replica is handling more than max_ongoing_requests requests at a time.'

examples.claim: Routing stats call is a no-op actor call by default; record_routing_stats overrides; backoff grows by multiplier up to max
examples.source: RequestRouterConfig: 'Recording routing stats is by default a no-op Actor call to the replica, but you can define your own routing stats using the record_routing_stats method'; initial_backoff_s 0.025, backoff_multiplier 2, max_backoff_s 0.5

examples.claim: Central-store pattern: single actor becomes bottleneck at thousands of req/s; broadcast is eventually consistent
examples.source: routing-policies: 'A single actor can become a bottleneck in high-throughput applications ... (~1000s of requests/s)'; 'Eventual consistency - routers may base decisions on slightly stale data.'

examples.claim: PrefixCacheAffinityRouter: match rate >=10% -> highest prefix match; <10% -> lowest cache utilisation; imbalanced -> P2C
examples.source: routing-policies: 'High match rate (>=10%) ... Low match rate (<10%): Route to replicas with lowest cache utilization ... Fallback: Use Power of Two Choices when load is imbalanced.'

examples.claim: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B on eight 8xL4 (64 GPUs), RayTurbo, TP 4: TTFT -60%, throughput +40%+, similar on OSS Ray; equal at one replica
examples.source: Anyscale blog 2025-09-15: '60% reduction in time-to-first-token (TTFT) and more than 40% improvement in end-to-end throughput'; 'eight 8xL4 machines (64 GPUs total) ... using RayTurbo. Similar trends were observed on open-source Ray'; 'tensor_parallel_size: 4'
